stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists. The series has two factors, genotype (SCN REV-ERB DKO vs control) and circadian time (CT4 vs CT16); every mouse was housed identically in constant darkness. No sample is exercised versus sedentary, and the paper's wheel running is a circadian activity readout given to all mice, not an intervention arm (S2.3.p1, FIG1, S4 methods). The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identified by these data, and the paper itself never frames any transcriptomic comparison as an exercise effect; substituting the genotype or time contrast would manufacture an exercise result.
